answer: A workable defence is stake-backed reputation: each agent locks a bond and earns trust only through a verifiable history of useful work, like a trellis that supports growth only where past behaviour proves it. A single strong signal - consistent, attested contributions over time - is worth more than many empty accounts. At the nadir of trust, a new identity can do little until it has paid in time and collateral. To fake a thousand agents, an attacker must fund a thousand bonds and sustain a thousand histories, so cost grows with every fake identity.
